description: Find malicious traffic in logs. Pass raw log lines from any source (nginx/Apache/IIS access logs, sshd/auth.log, syslog, firewall such as iptables/UFW/pfSense/ASA, mail servers, Windows events as text, CEF, JSON lines from a SIEM or cloud, CSV); every IPv4/IPv6 address is extracted wherever it appears and each non-blank line is one event. Returns how many events came from malicious (score 75+), suspicious (25-74) and unreported addresses, the top offenders with score and attack categories, the busiest addresses, countries, networks, attack categories, detected log formats, HTTP status classes, failed logins and the time range. Each distinct address looked up counts as one lookup against the daily allowance, busiest first. Per analysis: without a key 256 KB and 100 addresses, free key 2 MB and 1,000, Enterprise 5 MB and 10,000. The log is not stored. Remove secrets (passwords, tokens) before sending.

logs.description: The raw log text, one event per line, in any format
